interpretation.conflicting_duplicate: At least one original CSV column value differs from the first row with that normalized key
interpretation.exact_duplicate: All original parsed CSV column values identical to the first row with that normalized key
interpretation.identity_exceptions: Unconditional electorate identity mismatches retained; installed/not-installed strata reported separately; flags do not establish explanation
interpretation.missing_numeric: Empty, #NULO, #NE, -1, -3 are non-comparable; other invalid strings counted separately; never silently converted to zero in checks
interpretation.non_certification: Internal consistency of the provided snapshots, not independent verification against signed BUs, external electorate inventory, or official publication history
interpretation.raw_totals: Detail/vote totals include every selected raw row; duplicate keys are reported and ambiguous details excluded from section reconciliation
interpretation.reconciliation_denominators: vote_detail_* and vote_file_all_categories checks use matched unique sections only; *_all_unique_* checks additionally treat absence of vote records as zero for a unique detail key and accompany this with explicit detail-only diagnostics; missing numeric values are never zero-filled
interpretation.vote_classification: 95=blank; 96=null; 97=separate; all other positive NR_VOTAVEL=nominal for presidential scope; legend separately checked zero

method: Independent original-CSV streaming parser and binary-key dictionaries; integer arithmetic; no imports from primary H1/replay analysis
scope: 2026, CD_CARGO=1; all provided rounds and UFs including ZZ; original nationwide files only
